 Job Scan Home / Income Tax / CIT(E) fails to establish related party u/s 13(3): ITAT grants Relief in Foreign Funding of Eastern India Healthcare Foundation [Read Order] Income Tax Law Report CIT(E) fails to establish related party u/s 13(3): ITAT grants Relief in Foreign Funding of Eastern India Healthcare Foundation [Read Order] 
 Previous order alleged that assessment was erroneous because the trust had donated funds to Medica Hospitals, the apparent related party.
 By  Raheel Midhat · 29 Oct 2026, 2:30 pm IST 2′ read Save Get the day's tax rulings in your inbox 
 Email address Subscribe × Headnote The case number, coram and counsel for this order are part of the subscriber record. 
 Citation 2026 TAXSCAN (ITAT) 1477 Court Income Tax Appellate Tribunal Subscribe to view Read the Order Subscribers only In the Income Tax Litigation Tracker: more Tribunal rulings on Charitable trusts (12A, 80G) → 
 The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), Kolkata granted relief to assessee trust, Eastern India Healthcare Foundation in its income tax matter related to a foreign funding from Germany for covid-19 relief.
 The bench, quashing the revisionary proceedings against the trust, observed that the commissioner failed to establish how it was transacting with related party as per Section 13(3) of Income Tax Act, 1961. 
 The assessee trust, Eastern India Healthcare Foundation, filed its return of income declaring a nil income, which was subsequently accepted by the Assessing Officer under Section 143(3) of the Act after detailed scrutiny and verification of foreign donations received from DEG, Germany, pursuant to the Foreign Contribution Regulatory Act (FCRA), 2010.
